pr_body:
Fix gh-32075.

Notice jul isn't supported yet.

With this patch,  we can set different log level for console and file appenders without falling back to customized log4j.xml or logback-spring.xml.

Related questions on stackoverflow:

* https://stackoverflow.com/questions/51349261/how-to-set-different-logging-levels-for-console-writing-and-file-writing-in-java
* https://stackoverflow.com/questions/51277445/how-to-specify-specific-logger-level-for-each-of-file-writing-and-console-writin
pr_title: Allow different log level for FILE and CONSOLE appender

review_comment: It's filter level of appender, not log level of logger, TRACE means appender won't drop any log from logger by default.

It's filter level of appender, not log level of logger,  `TRACE` means appender won't drop any log from logger by default. For example,  `log.debug(...)` emit a debug level log, if the logger's log level is DEBUG, this log won't be dropped,  then the log is passed to file appender and console appender,  if filter level of file appender is TRACE, this log is written to file, if filter level of console appender is INFO, this log won't be written to console.
